qrMemory.scanTag: Scan the tag on the gift

howItWorks.description: Three steps, about ten minutes, and the rest is ours to make.

steps.chooseDescription: A puzzle, a mug, a QR memory or a boxed set. Every piece is made to order.
steps.personalizeDescription: Add the photo, the names and the message — then the private memory behind the tag.
steps.deliverDescription: Printed and packed by hand in 1–2 days, at your door in 3–5, paid on delivery.

showcase.description: Nothing here is printed before it is ordered. Every piece is proofed against your photo, packed the same day it comes off the press, and checked by the person who packs it.
showcase.caption: A finished order — one portrait, printed twice, boxed together.
showcase.printText: Colour-matched to your photo, proofed by eye before it goes on the press.
showcase.boxText: Rigid, lined, and closed with a ribbon — so the opening is part of the gift.
showcase.tagText: Kraft card, hand-tied, carrying the code to a page only they can reach.

socialProof.description: Every order leaves here made to order and packed by hand — and most of them arrive on a day someone had been planning for.
socialProof.madeToOrderDescription: Nothing is printed before you order it. Your photo is proofed by eye, then it goes on the press.
socialProof.codDescription: No card, no account, no prepayment. You pay in cash when the gift is in your hands.
socialProof.trackedDescription: Every order carries its own code. Follow it from the press to the doorstep, no sign-in needed.
socialProof.memoryDescription: Add a private page of photos, video and voice that they open by scanning the gift itself.

faq.personalizationA: Pick a gift, upload your photo and write your message. You see a live preview before you order, so nothing is printed until it looks exactly the way you want it.
faq.qrMemoryA: A private digital page attached to your gift. We print a small QR tag; when the person you gifted scans it, they open the photos, video, music and words you left for them. It stays online — they can come back to it whenever they want.
faq.videoA: Yes. A QR Memory can hold photos, one video, a voice note or a song, and a written message. You can update the contents later without reprinting anything.
faq.deliveryA: Personalized items are made to order. Production takes 1 to 2 working days, and delivery is 2 to 4 working days depending on your city.
faq.trackingA: Yes. You get a tracking link by SMS and email once your gift ships, and you can follow it at any time from the Track Order page.
faq.codA: Cash on Delivery is available across Morocco, alongside card payment at checkout.

finalCta.lead: Personalized gifts made for the moments that matter. Ten minutes now, a memory they keep for years.
